action_input.sql:
WITH colour_data AS (
    SELECT
        unnest(records).id AS colour_id,
        unnest(records).colour AS colour_name
    FROM read_json_auto('json/colour.json')
),
superhero_data AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        eye_colour_id
    FROM 'db/superhero.db'.superhero
)
SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN cd.colour_name = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(sd.id) AS percentage_blue_eyes
FROM superhero_data sd
LEFT JOIN colour_data cd ON sd.eye_colour_id = cd.colour_id;
